principles.text: Theme/sector strength is the number one factor in stock selection — pick names in the sector showing relative strength (here: software leading during the pullback while semis got crushed).
Focus on the long side and get aggressive when the market is pulling back into or holding above support (EMAs), not when it is at all-time highs and extended.
Down days during a pullback are the great entry opportunities — undercut-and-reclaim moves and failed breakdowns that break back out to the upside.
Take your fills off the open, then don't rush into further new trades — wait for the better level, e.g. the low of the previous day or the 60-minute 50 MA in the support area.
As long as price stays above the support level (9/21 EMA, anchored VWAP from the swing high), the position is fine — sideways action after entry is good enough; no need to act.
The ideal chart is a long base with EMAs clustered close together, inside days, in the right theme/sector — plus a weekly building higher lows (VCP-like).
